nodes.summary: Let $I$ be a finite set, and for each $i \in I$ let $p_i$ be a prime and $e_i$ a natural number. Then there are $k \in \mathbb{N}$ and natural numbers $d_0, \dots, d_{k-1}$ with $d_j > 1$ for every $j$ and $d_j \mid d_l$ whenever $j \le l$, such that $\bigoplus_{i \in I} \mathbb{Z}/p_i^{e_i}\mathbb{Z}$ is isomorphic to $\bigoplus_{j < k} \mathbb{Z}/d_j\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: From elementary divisors to invariant factors

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $A$ be an abelian group. If $A \cong \bigoplus_{i=1}^{n} \mathbb{Z}/p^{e_i}\mathbb{Z}$ and $A \cong \bigoplus_{j=1}^{m} \mathbb{Z}/p^{f_j}\mathbb{Z}$ for positive integers $e_1, \dots, e_n$ and $f_1, \dots, f_m$, then $n = m$ and the multisets $\{e_1, \dots, e_n\}$ and $\{f_1, \dots, f_m\}$ are equal.
nodes.title: Uniqueness of elementary divisors

nodes.summary: Every finite abelian group $A$ is isomorphic to $\bigoplus_{i < k} \mathbb{Z}/d_i\mathbb{Z}$ for some $k \in \mathbb{N}$ and natural numbers $d_0, \dots, d_{k-1}$ with $d_i > 1$ for every $i$ and $d_i \mid d_j$ whenever $i \le j$.
nodes.title: Invariant factor decomposition of finite abelian groups

nodes.summary: Every finitely generated abelian group $A$ is isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}^a \times \bigoplus_{i < k} \mathbb{Z}/d_i\mathbb{Z}$ for some $a, k \in \mathbb{N}$ and natural numbers $d_0, \dots, d_{k-1}$ with $d_i > 1$ for every $i$ and $d_i \mid d_j$ whenever $i \le j$.
nodes.title: Fundamental theorem of finitely generated abelian groups, invariant factor form

nodes.summary: If $A$ is a finitely generated abelian group, then its torsion subgroup is finitely generated.
nodes.title: Torsion subgroup of a finitely generated abelian group is finitely generated

nodes.summary: If $A$ is a finitely generated abelian group, then its torsion subgroup is finite.
nodes.title: Torsion subgroup of a finitely generated abelian group is finite

nodes.summary: If $A$ is a finitely generated abelian group, then there exist a natural number $n$ and positive integers $d_1, \dots, d_n$ such that the torsion subgroup of $A$ is isomorphic to the direct sum $\mathbb{Z}/d_1\mathbb{Z} \oplus \cdots \oplus \mathbb{Z}/d_n\mathbb{Z}$ of finite cyclic groups.
nodes.title: Torsion subgroup of a finitely generated abelian group as a sum of cyclic groups
